name: Inferno launch-control clutch (Apex V8)
_note: A triple-plate carbon clutch with launch control for the Apex: holds 3,200 N·m (more than the Inferno makes, so it counts as the triple-plate clutch the Inferno needs), bites twice as fast, weighs 4 kg, and the auto-clutch launches at 4,800 rpm instead of 3,800 with the turbos already spooling (tried from 3,800 to 6,800: 4,800 put the most down without spinning the tyres). With the Inferno and the rest of the Inferno set: 0–100 km/h in 2.6 s instead of 2.9, the quarter mile in 8.8 s instead of 9.0.
